svg.title: Power draw of the whole Mac with Omarchy in OmacVM.app, UTM, VMware Fusion and Parallels, and macOS itself
svg.desc: Idle (the desktop, nothing open): OmacVM.app 3.0.3 6.13 W (8.6 h), UTM 6.30 W (8.3 h), VMware Fusion 6.21 W (8.5 h), Parallels 6.17 W (8.5 h), macOS 5.20 W (10.1 h). Reading (Chrome scrolling a text page): OmacVM.app 3.0.3 6.11 W (8.6 h), UTM 7.43 W (7.1 h), VMware Fusion 6.82 W (7.7 h), Parallels 6.68 W (7.9 h), macOS 5.48 W (9.6 h). YouTube 4K (60 fps, SDR, in the browser that played it best): OmacVM.app 3.0.3 (Chromium, Mac's media engine) 10.10 W (5.2 h), UTM (Chromium, CPU) 16.46 W (3.2 h), VMware Fusion (Chrome, CPU, 11 % dropped) 16.14 W (3.3 h), Parallels (Chromium, CPU) 16.78 W (3.1 h), macOS (Chrome, hardware) 6.07 W (8.7 h). Every core busy (every core at 100 %: the VM's 4, the Mac's 8): OmacVM.app 3.0.3 21.01 W (2.5 h), UTM 16.95 W (3.1 h), VMware Fusion 18.16 W (2.9 h), Parallels 18.01 W (2.9 h), macOS 19.69 W (2.7 h). WebGL Aquarium (30,000 fish in Chrome; each draws its own frame rate): OmacVM.app 3.0.3 (19 fps) 17.11 W (3.1 h), UTM (21 fps) 18.15 W (2.9 h), VMware Fusion (25 fps) 20.64 W (2.5 h), Parallels (17 fps) 17.43 W (3.0 h), macOS (60 fps, the display's limit) 17.34 W (3.0 h). Watts, lower is better; hours on a full battery.
svg.text: How much power does the Mac draw?
